notes: - **Choose the size for a whole batch**: when you generate several textures (**Generate selected** or **Generate all that need art**), the dialog now asks for the **Size** as well as the detail - keep each texture's own size, or paint every item and block at 16×16, 32×32, 64×64, 128×128 or 256×256. GUIs and mobs keep their own size so their slots and body parts still match your code. The button shows exactly what you'll get, e.g. "Generate 12 · Ultra Detail · 32×32".
